name: LingoQA
intro: LingoQA是一个针对自动驾驶领域视觉问答的新型数据集和基准。该数据集包含2.8万个独特的短视频场景和41.9万个标注。对最先进的视觉语言模型进行评估表明，它们的性能仍低于人类水平。LingoQA引入了一个名为Lingo-Judge的真实性分类器，其与人类评估的Spearman相关系数达到0.95，超越了现有技术。该基准旨在作为自动驾驶视觉语言模型的评估平台。
build_method: 动作与场景双分支标注, GPT-3.5/GPT-4辅助问答生成, 双人评测标注
scale: 28K个四秒视频场景, 419.9K条问答标注
build_method_en: Action/scenery dual pipelines, GPT-3.5/GPT-4-assisted QA generation, double-labeled human evaluation set
intro_en: LingoQA is a novel dataset and benchmark for visual question answering in the autonomous driving domain. It contains 28,000 unique short video scenes and 419,000 annotations. Evaluations of state-of-the-art vision-language models show their performance still lags behind human level. LingoQA introduces Lingo-Judge, a fidelity classifier with a Spearman correlation of 0.95 against human evaluations, surpassing existing methods. This benchmark aims to serve as an evaluation platform for autonomous driving vision-language models.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2312.14115, Sections 3–4 and Tables 2–3. LingoQA extracts four-second driving scenarios at 1 Hz and builds data through separate Action and Scenery branches. Action seeds combine operator behavior descriptions, perception/vehicle metadata, prompt templates, and GPT-3.5 rephrasing, answering, and extension; Scenery data densely annotates three 30-minute sessions in ELAN across about 15 caption categories and uses GPT-4 chain-of-thought prompting. The unambiguous aggregate is 28K scenarios and 419.9K QA annotations; the paper's prose and Table 3 disagree on the Action-branch QA subtotal, so the diagram does not assert that disputed subtotal. More than 20 in-house evaluators create 500 questions and two independently authored answers per question, with repeated relabeling of semantic disagreements. DeBERTaV3 Lingo-Judge uses question, reference answer, and model answer without video, takes the maximum over references, reaches 95% held-out accuracy, and correlates with human model rankings at Spearman 0.950 and Pearson 0.993.
